tools.name: search
tools.description: Find Steam games by name or by genre/tag words (e.g. 'elden ring', 'final fantasy 7', 'cozy farming', 'soulslike'). Returns up to 20 games with Steam review score and count, year, top community tags and a steamcozy.com link. Use fetch with a result's id for the full record. Adult-only titles are never returned.

query.description: Game name or genre/tag words, any language.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read one Steam game's record from steamcozy.com by its id from search/find_games (a Steam app id) or its slug. Returns Markdown with review score and count, price with the lowest since tracking began (2026-07), community tags, what reviewers agree on (praise and criticism with counts), achievement completion, latest official announcements, similar games and links — each with its as-of date. Adult-only titles are not available.

id.description: Steam app id (e.g. '1245620') or steamcozy slug (e.g. 'elden-ring').

tools.name: find_games
tools.description: Discover Steam games by community tags (up to 4, all must apply, e.g. ['cozy','farming']) and/or 'like' a given game (its id → SteamCozy's precomputed similar games). Optional floors on review count and positive %, release year, free only. Results are ordered by how prominently the tags apply, then popularity. Adult-only titles are never returned.

tags.description: Community tag names (as on Steam), e.g. 'Roguelike', 'Souls-like', 'Cozy', 'Co-op'.

like.description: A Steam app id: return games similar to it (from its SteamCozy page).

released_after.description: Only games released in this year or later.

tools.name: new_games
tools.description: This month's Steam releases as shown on steamcozy.com/new/: 'popular' (Steam's own 'Popular new releases' order, re-baked daily — order only, no sales numbers), 'just_released' (this week and last, with a review floor), 'ea_graduates' (left Early Access), 'cozy' (this month's cozy releases) and 'steam_chart' (Steam's official top releases of the previous month, gold/silver/bronze). Each item has a steamcozy.com or Steam link, review score and tags.

block.description: One block in full; omit for a digest of all blocks (10 items each).
